clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

C.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
C.logical_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

A.logical_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

full.scope: Counters are sequential before/after snapshots; probe prefix/stop is nearby but not identical to those brackets. They are not a shared exact time interval for deriving devices/call or per-reason costs.

limitations: Reason labels overlap on an endpoint request. Effective includes dirty checkpoints and any committed/received result, not asset-business-only work.
Signals, captured reasons and effective reasons are different events. No ratio is interpreted as business share, global fairness, wasted work, or per-reason SQL/WAL time.
Absent reason fields, especially all f3 fields, remain UNMEASURED. Missing/partial JVM counter sums are never presented as a measured total.
Histograms are method call wall times across the selected threads, not CPU usage or an E2E critical path. Nested phases overlap; their sums must not be added as total runtime cost.
No per-call device/request size hook exists in this FE archive; those values stay UNMEASURED. One endpoint argument is not proof that an invocation completed useful work.
wal_write includes identical-snapshot returns; SQL_transaction counts Java helper calls, not physical transactions. Notification_fanout names wakeChannel only.
Probe and counter boundaries differ slightly. Fixed precedes drain; full includes actual drain/quiet. Every layout/JVM and both scopes are preserved.
n1 layouts and instrumented-root quantiles do not prove general production tails, uninstrumented work or performance acceptance.
